answer: The spiral schedule is applied in pearl and thread shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4723 identities would post 4025 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
